tests.name: dc_regulation
tests.message: worst |vout-1.0V| over the 0-20mA DC sweep = 3169mV at tt/1.5V/+27C/vmin_v (max 30mV)

finish_summary: Implemented and froze /app/circuit.spi as a transistor-level PMOS-pass LDO with an internal 150k/100k feedback divider, differential NMOS error stage, resistor-derived bias, pass gate driver, and 100pF output / 100pF compensation capacitance. The public DC development bench at tt/27C/1.65V reported approximately 1.0046–1.0048V across 0–20mA and 87.2uA no-load VIN current. However, transient step measurements showed catastrophic numerical output excursions (down to roughly -320V and up to 1.64V); the dynamic requirements are not met. Only the nominal DC bench was evaluated after the final topology. Full corner, line, temperature, PSR, startup and formal signoff remain unverified.
